candidates.name: Lightspeed Restaurant
candidates.description: Offers an integrated cloud-based point of sale and commerce platform serving the hospitality and retail sectors.
candidates.rationale: Lightspeed Restaurant provides cloud POS and commerce tools for hospitality businesses, overlapping Toast’s core restaurant operations platform and buyer persona.

candidates.name: TouchBistro
candidates.description: Provides an all-in-one iPad-based restaurant management system specifically designed for food service operations.
candidates.rationale: TouchBistro offers restaurant POS and management software for the same food-service operators and operational needs as Toast.

candidates.name: SpotOn
candidates.description: Delivers a comprehensive restaurant technology platform featuring point-of-sale, team management, and online ordering tools.
candidates.rationale: SpotOn offers restaurant POS, online ordering, and workforce management, directly overlapping Toast’s platform and targeting the same restaurant operators.

candidates.name: ParTech, Inc.
candidates.description: Provides a unified restaurant management platform that integrates point-of-sale, scheduling, and back-office tools.
candidates.rationale: PAR offers restaurant POS and management software for the same restaurant operators and overlapping operational jobs as Toast.

candidates.name: Tabit Technologies Inc.
candidates.description: Operates a specialized mobile-first restaurant point-of-sale system built to enhance front-of-house operations.
candidates.rationale: Tabit offers restaurant-focused point-of-sale software for front-of-house operations, overlapping Toast’s core POS product and restaurant buyer persona.

candidates.name: HungerRush, LLC
candidates.description: Offers restaurant management systems that bundle point-of-sale software with integrated online ordering solutions.
candidates.rationale: HungerRush directly overlaps Toast in restaurant point-of-sale, online ordering, and management software for restaurant operators.

candidates.name: GoTab, Inc.
candidates.description: Provides an entertainment commerce platform that optimizes guest ordering and payment experiences for hospitality venues.
candidates.rationale: GoTab offers ordering, payments, and commerce technology for hospitality venues, overlapping Toast’s restaurant POS and guest transaction platform.

candidates.name: Focus POS, Inc.
candidates.description: Develops specialized restaurant point-of-sale software and management solutions for the food service industry.
candidates.rationale: Both provide restaurant-focused point-of-sale and management platforms evaluated by food-service operators for the same operational needs.

candidates.name: Restaurant365, LLC.
candidates.description: Specializes in back-office restaurant management software covering accounting, operations, and workforce scheduling.
candidates.rationale: Both provide restaurant operations and workforce-management software to restaurant owners and operators, creating overlapping buyer personas and jobs to be done.

candidates.name: Clover Network, Inc.
candidates.description: Provides a versatile point-of-sale platform that allows restaurants to manage orders, payments, and staff operations.
candidates.rationale: Clover offers restaurant point-of-sale, payment, order, and staff-management tools, directly overlapping Toast’s core platform and buyer persona.

candidates.name: Shift4 Corporation
candidates.description: Integrates payment processing technology specifically tailored for the hospitality and restaurant industries.
candidates.rationale: Shift4 provides restaurant and hospitality payment-processing technology, overlapping Toast’s payments offering and targeting the same restaurant operators and buyers.

candidates.name: Ecisolutions
candidates.description: Provides industry-specific business management and ERP software designed for operational automation.
candidates.rationale: ECI provides ERP software for manufacturing and distribution industries, not restaurant-focused POS, payments, ordering, and operations tools.

candidates.name: Aptos
candidates.description: Offers unified commerce and management solutions that assist retailers and hospitality businesses with digital operations.
candidates.rationale: Aptos primarily serves general retailers with unified commerce software, not restaurant-specific POS and operations buyers who would evaluate Toast.

candidates.name: Square Inc.
candidates.description: Offers a broad suite of point-of-sale and business management tools widely used by small and medium-sized restaurants.
candidates.rationale: Square offers restaurant-focused POS, payments, online ordering, and management tools, serving substantially the same merchants and operational needs as Toast.

candidates.name: Certinia Inc.
candidates.description: Provides cloud-based financial management and service operations software often used to track complex business metrics.
candidates.rationale: Certinia provides enterprise financial and professional-services operations software, not restaurant POS, ordering, payments, or restaurant-focused operations tools.

candidates.name: Focus Softnet Pvt Ltd
candidates.description: Delivers ERP and business management software that assists enterprises with operational tracking and financial workflows.
candidates.rationale: Focus Softnet primarily offers general enterprise ERP, not a restaurant-focused POS, payments, ordering, and operations platform.

candidates.name: CSG
candidates.description: Provides customer engagement and billing solutions that help businesses manage complex payment and service transactions.
candidates.rationale: CSG provides enterprise billing and customer-engagement software, not restaurant-focused POS, ordering, payments, or operations tools evaluated by restaurant operators.

candidates.name: Ramp
candidates.description: Focuses on spend management and automated expense tracking tools for small and medium-sized business operations.
candidates.rationale: Ramp provides general corporate spend management, not restaurant POS, ordering, payments acceptance, or restaurant operations software; buyers and jobs differ.

candidates.name: Freshworks Inc.
candidates.description: Provides unified service software used by businesses to manage customer interactions and operational support.
candidates.rationale: Freshworks provides general customer service and IT support software, not restaurant POS, payments, ordering, payroll, or restaurant operations technology.

candidates.name: Biposervice
candidates.description: Offers cloud-based HR and payroll management solutions that assist businesses with workforce and administrative tasks.
candidates.rationale: Biposervice is a general HR/payroll platform, not a restaurant POS, payments, ordering, and operations platform serving Toast’s core use case.
